desc.zh:
曲江城区公交位于广东省韶关市马坝镇，设有3条线路。
2018年12月7日，韶关汽车客运南站为确保公交线路优化调整工作科学、规范、有序推进，更好地体现民意，将《韶关汽车客运南站关于公交线路优化调整的方案》（征求意见稿）通过各种媒体进行社会公示，向社会公开征求意见，期间，收集各类意见及建议近百条。在此基础上，该站又于2019年1月17日特邀请曲江经济开发区、松山职业技术学院、曲江中学、曹溪温泉度假村等10余个单位代表及市民代表在该站二楼会议室进行座谈，征集意见和建议。并根据市民建议和公交运行客流分析，通过前期实地走访和踏勘，制定了线路调整初步方案，新增设城区3条公交线路，新线路的增设，充分体现了民意。
desc.en: Qujiang Urban Area Bus Service is located in Maba Town, Shaoguan City, Guangdong Province, and has 3 routes. On December 7, 2018, in order to ensure that the optimization and adjustment of bus routes at Shaoguan South Bus Station were carried out scientifically, standardly, and orderly, and to better reflect public opinion, the station publicly announced the "Plan for the Optimization and Adjustment of Bus Routes at Shaoguan South Bus Station (Draft for Comments)" through various media channels to solicit opinions from the public. During this period, nearly a hundred opinions and suggestions were collected. Based on this, on January 17, 2019, the station specially invited representatives from more than ten organizations, including Qujiang Economic Development Zone, Songshan Vocational and Technical College, Qujiang Middle School, and Caoxi Hot Spring Resort, as well as citizen representatives, to a meeting held in the second-floor conference room of the station to gather opinions and suggestions. According to citizen feedback and bus passenger flow analysis, and after preliminary on-site visits and inspections, a preliminary plan for route adjustments was developed, adding 3 new urban bus routes. The addition of new routes fully reflects public opinion.
